programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: Zona's Awesome Fishing Show
programme.desc: The unpredictable nature of fishing is why the sport is, well, awesome. That's the opinion of former professional angler Mark Zona, who demonstrates on his Outdoor Channel show the allure of not knowing what's going to happen with each cast. Episodes might start with a targeted species, but that's where the scripts end. What happens after that -- the successes and the failures, the magic and the miseries, the ecstasies and the agonies -- keep viewers guessing on what the next bite may bring. Zona's TV career began in 2005 as the co-host of "Loudmouth Bass." He has also provided analysis on Bassmaster tournament telecasts.

programme.title: Live: NFL GameDay Morning
programme.desc: Rich Eisen leads a cast of NFL talent through four hours of pregame hype, prepping viewers for the kickoffs of Sunday's games. The latest news from around the league, reports from game sites and interviews with players and coaches are featured, and insider Ian Rapoport provides late-breaking news.

programme.title: NFL GameDay Live
programme.desc: Expanding on NFL Network's "GameDay" programming on Sundays during football season, "GameDay Live" updates viewers on what's happening throughout the league. Beginning with kickoff of early-afternoon events and continuing throughout late-afternoon contests, the studio show offers nearly immediate highlights of scoring and other notable plays. But the program is about more than the action; it intersperses highlights of press conferences, interviews with players and coaches, and live reports by announcers at game sites.

After failing with his new team of misfits, Buttermaker enlists feisty and gifted pitcher Amanda Whurlitzer (Tatum O'Neal) to lead the charge -- but can he find the luck and patience to whip these outcasts into shape?

programme.title: MLB Tonight
programme.desc: When they're not tuning in to the games themselves, baseball fans know where to turn for their nightly baseball fix. MLB Network's signature program, "MLB Tonight" presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast. The Emmy-winning studio show features highlights, live look-ins and breaking news, plus analysis from a rotating roster that includes former players Eric Byrnes, Al Leiter, Dan Plesac, Billy Ripken and Mike Lowell, and inside information men Tom Verducci, Jon Heyman, Peter Gammons and Ken Rosenthal. Greg Amsinger, Brian Kenny and Matt Vasgersian are among the hosts.

programme.title: Masters Highlights

programme.title: Masters Highlights
programme.desc: Tiger Woods plays steady, and sometimes spectacular, golf to capture his third Masters. He joins Jack Nicklaus (1965-66) and Nick Faldo (1989-90) as the only players to successfully defend their title.

programme.title: U.S. Open Golf Highlights
programme.desc: Tiger Woods continued his trek towards the Grand Slam by winning the 2002 U.S. Open at Bethpage State Park in N.Y. and becomes the first golfer to win the first two legs of the Grand Slam in the same year since Jack Nicklaus in 1972.

programme.title: Masters Highlights

programme.title: PGA Championship Highlights

programme.title: U.S. Open Golf Highlights

programme.title: Masters Highlights
